The '''Ehosiq sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

The [[House Benelex|Benelex Bounty Hunters Guild]] was active in this sector.<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>
